races.verdict: MERISI DIAMOND has quickly dropped to 2 lb below the mark he defied here in the spring and is worth siding with under Dylan Browne McMonagle. Second choice is Nouvel Espoir , who has been in cracking form since the start of the summer and also has the services of a top jockey. All The Girls is well handicapped on all-weather form and is also shortlisted along with Tolebi . MERISI DIAMOND (IRE) NOUVEL ESPOIR (IRE) ALL THE GIRLS (IRE)
